title: Life Admin & Paperwork Weekend vs Weekday Split
dataSources: Life-admin document records (`lifeadmin:document`), passport status (`passport:status`), warranty registrations (`warranty:registration`), document-scan index (`documentscan:index`), voter-registration records (`voter:registration`).
app: Passport and document trackers, warranty-registration forms, document-scan indexes, and voter-registration reminders streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and mobile capture workflows.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=passport:status
| eval day_type=if(in(strftime(_time,"%u"),"6","7"),"weekend","weekday")
| stats count as events, avg(duration_min) as avg_duration by day_type
description: Separates life admin activity between weekdays and weekends when duration is present.
value: Weekend/weekday splits quickly show whether a life domain is work-driven, leisure-driven, or bleeding into the wrong days.
implementation: Populate optional `duration_min` on `passport:status` events if available; the search still works on counts alone when duration is missing.
visualization: Side-by-side bar chart of weekday vs weekend event counts.
grandmaExplanation: It works out whether your life admin activity mostly happens on weekdays or weekends so you can see if the habit fits the life you actually live.
